PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a defensive stance, limit exposure to the weakest sectors and avoid treating isolated relative strength as a confirmed market reversal. Consider only selective, risk-controlled exposure to FROTO (1W: +2.12% | 1M: -6.74%) — RECOVERY; breadth remains 0/8 positive.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Watch for follow-through in FROTO (1W: +2.12% | 1M: -6.74%) — RECOVERY and stabilization in TUPRS (1W: -0.14% | 1M: -7.60%) — BELOW TREND. YKBNK (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -0.39%) — BELOW TREND and ENKAI (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -9.78%) — BELOW TREND are relative performers to monitor, not confirmed breakouts.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Monitor Holding & Investment and Banking & Finance for signs that relative resilience broadens into positive weekly returns. Track Energy & Chemicals for stabilization after the sharpest sector decline; no sector posted a positive 1W return.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
No XU100 support/resistance levels or specific catalysts were supplied, so price levels cannot be stated reliably. Key signals are breadth moving above 0/8 and volatility easing below 25%; continued negative breadth would reinforce a defensive stance.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

BIST 50 conditions are weak beneath the supplied NEUTRAL regime label: volatility is normal at 26.6%, but breadth is 0/8 and every sector is negative on the week. FROTO’s RECOVERY is a relative bright spot, while Energy & Chemicals and Heavy Industry carry the sharpest downside risk; confirmation requires broader participation.
